''See also: [[Fingerling Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Fingerling is a pink, serpentine [[dragon]] that serves as the bound [[spirit]] and manifestation of [[Jai Chen]]'s power. Originally roughly the size of a finger, the creature earned its name from its diminutive starting size and a fondness for consuming small fish. As an extension of [[Jai Chen]], the [[dragon]] possesses unique pink [[madra]] that behaves differently than standard fire; instead of flames, it manifests as a dense cloud or destructive pink light capable of dissolving enemies. Fingerling is capable of flight and can engage in combat, either by using its breath to chip away at techniques or by physically wrestling opponents. The [[spirit]] is highly expressive, capable of trilling with excitement, keening in agitation to alert others of danger, or showing exhaustion during battle.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Fingerling is a pink, serpentine [[dragon]] [[spirit]]. The creature has been observed flying around its bonded partner and crooning upon their shoulder.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The [[spirit]] remains alert while flying around [[Jai Chen]]. It also expresses itself through high-pitched keening noises and crooning.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Fingerling is a pink serpentine [[dragon]] [[spirit]] bonded to [[Jai Chen]]. This [[spirit]] also engages in battle against [[Little Blue]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|This [[spirit]] can breathe a strange pink [[madra]] and spray destructive pink light. Additionally, [[Jai Chen]] is able to unleash the Fingerling [[technique]].}}
